Definition: prolonged from G4130; flood-tide, i.e. (by analogy) a freshet:--flood.
BiblicalUsage: Plemmyra is a flood, the rising water that tests a house. Jesus uses it once, in Luke 6:48: the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon the house founded on the rock, and could not shake it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the flood finds every house, and only the rock holds.
